event.description: Fantasy Fest is Key West’s legendary 10-day party in paradise — a vibrant celebration of creativity, community, and pure island magic. What began in 1979 as a local idea to liven up the island’s quiet season has transformed into an internationally recognized festival that takes over the streets of Old Town every October. Each year, artists, adventurers, and free spirits from around the world flock to Key West to transform the island with spectacular costumes, lively parades, and unforgettable parties. Imagination runs wild, costumes turn heads, and the island pulses with unstoppable energy. Now more than four decades strong, Fantasy Fest isn’t just an event — it’s a Key West tradition, a state of mind, and a one-of-a-kind experience you’ll never forget. Festival details coming soon!
